semantics.kv_skap_vault: Maintains the verifier for the user and is the sole source of user-verification state.
semantics.stegos_device: An interchangeable StegOS transport node. Device identity, node identity, transport channel identity, local key possession, and local hardware do not establish user-verifier authority.
semantics.node_local_capability: A node may expose and invoke locally available non-exportable capabilities after applicable KV/SKAP-backed verification state and Interlock/InTr admission are bound to the exact operation. Local enforcement does not make the node the user verifier.
semantics.transport_integrity: A transport may preserve integrity, freshness, routing, replay protection, and evidence bindings without becoming a user verifier or trust root for the user.
semantics.device_interchangeability: Replacing one eligible StegOS device/node with another does not change the user's verifier. Only the available local capability endpoint and resulting evidence may change.
